name: Kappa
verdict: A brand of BasicNet S.p.A., an Italian group listed on Borsa Italiana since 1999. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: OGC Nice's kit maker (équipementier) and one of the club's three principal partners; also kit supplier to Al-Kholood and to the Tunisia national team (2026 World Cup). Technical partner (teamwear) of the Pertamina Enduro VR46 Racing Team (team's 2026 Sponsors page). Owner chain checked: listed Italian holding company; no state shareholder identified, no human-rights finding found.
